grok.pulse: NQ futures +2.5% into the Black Friday half-day on the AI/China rebound and the 4.3% Q3 GDP upgrade, offset by Hormuz escalation (IRGC mine/tanker and F-16 warning-shot claims, Brent ~$98), Goldman's $100B CTA-selling warning and an NVDA China-diversion headline in thin liquidity.
grok.bias: mixed — big overnight bid and China stimulus lean risk-on, but Iran/Hormuz oil spike, CTA supply, hawkish ECB/Fed hike pricing and half-day thin volume make the gap fade-prone.
items: @DeItaone (~6:38 AM ET): Goldman warns systematic funds could sell another $100B of global equities over the next week — Bearish NQ
@DeItaone (~6:46 AM ET): $NVDA Blackwell chips surface at Shanghai data center tied to Megaspeed (export-control risk) — Bearish NQ
Reuters/X News (~7:30 AM ET): IRGC says two tankers hit mines near Khasab and it fired warning shots at a US F-16 in Hormuz; Brent ~$97.8 — Bearish NQ
@DeItaone (~7:28 AM ET): Trump says victory in Iran war is 'within reach', timing of end left open — Mixed NQ
@FirstSquawk (~7:04-7:11 AM ET): PBOC vows to support domestic demand, keep yuan stable; China national team rally +15% on the week — Bullish NQ
grok.trump: Called the pre-election Q3 GDP numbers 'FAKE' after the upgrade to 4.3% and demanded an investigation (~7:15 AM ET via @zerohedge); says victory in the Iran war is 'within reach' (~7:28 AM ET); warned any strike would hit Iran's Pickaxe Mountain site; USTR proposed Section 301 tariffs on 14 partners (China up to 40%).
grok.watch: Fri Nov 27: cash open 9:30 AM, early close 1:00 PM ET (CME equity futures 1:15 PM); Hormuz/IRGC headlines and Brent $98; Fed blackout starts midnight Sat Nov 28; OPEC+ Sunday; MRVL/OKTA Mon Dec 1 AMC, CRM/SNOW Tue Dec 2 AMC; Dec 9 FOMC.

reports.pulse: Black Friday half-day opens with NQ futures +2.5% and ES +1.7% on AI rebound plus China support after Thanksgiving, while Brent near $97 keeps a Middle East risk premium from Hormuz mines and Houthi strikes amid thin liquidity.
